Name: Resident Evil comes to the Valley
Author: leincognite
Description:
Hello there! This mod adds various characters from Resident Evil, right now, it has:
[list]
[*]Leon S. Kennedy[/*]
[*]Chris Redfield[/*]
[*]Jill Valentine[/*]
[*]Claire Redfield[/*]
[*]Rebecca Chambers[/*]
[*]William Birkin[/*]
[*]Carlos Oliveira[/*]
[/list]Currently, it has 30 lines approximately per character, and everyone is romanceable! In future updates I plan on adding:
[list]
[*]More lines per character[/*]
[*]More characters (Albert Wesker, Luis Sera and Ethan Winters, but if you want anyone specific, feel free to ask for them!)[/*]
[*]Heart events[/*]
[*]Introduction events[/*]
[/list][size=6]New Update![/size]
[size=3]So, I fixed the problem with the gifts, the mayority of the characters has new dialogues, in the next update, I plan on adding new dialogues for the rest of the characters, and add Albert Wesker. :)[/size]
